title: State Secrets
description: Magistrate Holt keeps a decree in his office vault that lets the crown seize everything we have and take our people without a trial. It is signed and waiting on an excuse. I want it out of that vault.

objectives.description: Meet the inside contact for the guards' rounds
Get into Magistrate Holt's offices unseen
Break the vault holding the decree
objectives.notes: QuestInteractable magistrate_vault rolls this DC itself; a failed pick costs the attempt, never the quest

objectives.description: Take the decree that could end the Guild
Get the decree to the Guild hideout before lockdown

challenge.description: Multiple guards, magical wards, complex locks, time pressure

phases.name: escape
phases.description: Once documents taken, 3-minute timer before full lockdown

moral_choice.description: Reading the documents reveals the decree would actually legalize Guild operations. You can steal them for the Guild or leave them to help legitimize thieves.
moral_choice.evil_option: Steal documents - maintain Guild's shadow status

leave_documents.future_impact: Guild becomes semi-legal but loses underworld power

steal_documents.future_impact: Guild maintains criminal power, royal opposition continues

notes: Meets Guildmaster Nightshade. High-difficulty heist. Complex multi-phase challenge. Rewards Shadowstep Boots (mobility item). Magistrate offices in Dalhurst government district, magistrate named Holt (invented, no bible basis, matches the unnamed magistrate in lady_nightshade.json dialogue). Threat: the decree, described in full per this pass rather than only in the decorative moral_choice block. Giver motive: Nightshade moves first rather than wait for the crown to act. Consequence: the moral_choice (leave the decree to legitimize the Guild) is decorative - obj_steal_documents is the only wired path, so the description no longer pretends otherwise.
